tools.name: get_student_today_lesson
tools.title: Get today's lesson
tools.description: Return the current student's lesson of the day (title, subtitle, duration) along with their first name and cohort.

tools.name: get_student_progress
tools.title: Get student progress
tools.description: Return the child student's Juzʾ ʿAmma learning path (each surah with its status) and the reviews scheduled for today.

tools.name: get_parent_weekly_summary
tools.title: Get parent's weekly summary
tools.description: Return the parent's overview: children, attendance status, weekly stats (lessons, minutes, memorized surahs, homework), and next scheduled step.

tools.name: get_teacher_cohort_overview
tools.title: Get teacher's cohort overview
tools.description: Return the teacher's cohort snapshot: student attendance breakdown, per-student summaries, homework awaiting grading, and next Zoom session.
